rules: Statistical class: Validated means beating the benchmark out of sample with a 95% range above zero (intraday models must also be calibrated, hold in each VIX regime seen, and add economic value). Promising means it beat the benchmark but failed one condition, or was tested only on data already inspected. Economic class is separate and is measured with costs. Multiple testing uses 805 distinct configurations in the ledger.
